papers.note: S755 updated on 2026-07-08 from Table 1 of Adams et al. 2024. Added combined injuryOutcome values for HSI plus time-loss groin injury by arm because the component outcomes are disjoint and use the same control/intervention player-hour denominators. Control combined count 19 = 10 HSI + 9 groin; intervention combined count 26 = 18 HSI + 8 groin. Incidence and burden were summed within arm: overall incidence 2.45/1.93, match incidence 7.02/3.63, training incidence 0.87/1.43, overall burden 40.55/31.64. Component location rows remain unchanged. Did not aggregate confidence intervals or mean days lost. Cleared illnessTotalCount because the previous 19/26 values were injury counts, not illness outcomes.
